title: Unit 23 Consolidation: The City and Its Buildings
goal: I can use the words for city plans, facades and the preservation debate.
I can use -va/-ve participles, participles before the noun and *míg … addig* to describe and contrast buildings.
I can use firm judgements and density adverbs when writing about a city.
